Mnimi is a Simon-style memory game (not a pair-matching board). Upstream
pulls SweetAlert, particles.js, Font Awesome, and Bensound MP3s from the
page; none of those ride in this GIF.

vendor/script.js is the original js/script.js (the rules: 4 pads, a growing
sequence, extra pads after level 7 and 14, speed 2500→550). app.js is the
classic-script port of those rules: gifos.db for best score, a race over
Invite, no CDN, no music.
